jobs.title: Chief Product Technology Officer - Classter
jobs.jd_full:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. We are on a mission to acquire, build, and grow great companies worldwide, helping them modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Banyan is Great Place to Work Certified, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top 10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, EU, and APAC.

Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO) · Classter

Location: Remote (Kavala, Greece HQ)

Compensation: €100,000 – €120,000 gross per annum, plus benefits. Offers are anchored within this published range based on the experience and scope the candidate brings.

About Banyan:

Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. We are on a mission to acquire, build, and grow great companies worldwide, helping them modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Banyan is Great Place to Work Certified, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top 10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, EU, and APAC.

About Classter:

Classter is an end-to-end, modular Student Information System (SIS) for education. It gives institutions a single system of record in place of multiple legacy tools, covering admissions, academics, the full student lifecycle, LMS, CRM, communication, billing and payments, with mobile apps on top. We serve private institutions, from K-12 and academies to higher education, across more than 40 countries. Our strongest base is in Greece and Cyprus and across Europe, with a growing footprint in North America and beyond. Classter is part of Banyan Software, a permanent-capital holder of vertical software businesses. Banyan backs its companies for the long term, with no exit clock and no pressure to optimize for a sale.

The Role:

Classter has a strong, feature-rich product and a solid engineering organization. The next phase is scale. It starts with a clear product vision and an ambitious roadmap, delivered through an AI-centric approach, a solid architecture, and a proactive motion that leverages Classter's proven, unique expertise. To match that ambition, we are creating a new seat. As CPTO you own Product and Engineering together. It is product-led, the center of gravity is product, and it is a real technology leadership seat, not a product role with engineering bolted on. You report directly to the CEO, work alongside your peers the COO and the head of Sales, and lead experienced Product and Engineering teams already in place.

What you will own

  • Product vision, roadmap and prioritization, end to end. This is the core of the role, and more so as AI reshapes the product.
  • Product direction and priority arbitration across the company, done in the open with the CEO and the leadership team.
  • The engineering organization: its structure, delivery, quality and growth. You lead it through its team leads and own its direction and standards.
  • Alignment of Product with go-to-market, the ideal customer profile and Sales, so the company builds with intent and stops shipping ad hoc.
  • Technical strategy and architecture, keeping the platform coherent, scalable and secure, and able to support the roadmap.
  • Predictable delivery, turning the roadmap into shipped software at a reliable pace.
  • A deliberate approach to AI, in the product and in how the team builds, with a clear business model behind it.

Your first twelve months

  • A product vision and roadmap the whole company understands and can execute against.
  • A shift from a reactive, request-driven motion to a proactive, roadmap-driven one.
  • Product, ICP and go-to-market visibly aligned (in collaboration with the other C's), with ad hoc development materially reduced.
  • A credible plan to scale the product architecture, sequenced and underway.
  • Engineering delivering to the roadmap at a predictable pace, with clear standards in place.
  • At least one meaningful AI move, in the product or in how the team builds, with a business model attached.

The team you will lead

You report to the CEO and sit on the leadership team. You lead six teams, each with an existing lead: Product Design & Analysis, Main Product Development, Mobile App and AI Features Development, Architecture and Integrations, Quality Assurance, and Technical Operations. You inherit a capable engineering organization with established leads, and strong product domain expertise. Your focus is direction and leadership.

What we are looking for

Essential

  • A senior leader who has owned both Product and Engineering, or a product leader who has genuinely run engineering. Strong track record in B2B SaaS, ideally vertical software.
  • You have owned product vision, roadmap and prioritization at scale. You decide, you do not only facilitate.
  • You have led engineering organizations: architecture and technical strategy, delivery and quality, structuring and growing a team. Credible with engineers, not a manager who delegates the technology.
  • Experience taking a complex, feature-rich product and making its architecture coherent and scalable.
  • A clear point of view on AI, in the product and in engineering, with a business model behind it.
  • You align product tightly with go-to-market and the ideal customer profile.
  • You bring direction to a founder-led company and an established team without steamrolling them.

Nice to have

  • Education, EdTech, or another regulated, workflow-heavy vertical.
  • International, multi-market SaaS.
  • Experience in a founder-led company moving from craft to scale.
  • Exposure to M&A and product integration.

Why this role

  • A real ownership seat across product and engineering, with the mandate to shape where Classter goes.
  • A strong product and team to build on, not a turnaround from zero.
  • A permanent-capital owner behind you, with a long-term horizon.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Campaign Pages
jobs.jd_full:
Highlights

  • Location: Georgia, Remote (CET)
  • Language:Russian-speaking team; English fluency required (C1)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9⁄5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About the Role

A great campaign page doesn’t just tell a story. It turns a visitor into a donor.

Campaign Pages are where nonprofits launch campaigns, tell their stories and convert donors before checkout. They sit close to revenue, next to Checkout Modal and Elements in our Pre-Donation Experience. You will be the one person accountable for the Campaign Pages roadmap, quality and delivery. Your job is to make the product scalable, ready for enterprise customers and a clear driver of revenue, while traffic keeps growing and the product stays stable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Campaign Pages strategy and a 6–12 month roadmap aligned with Product and Pre-Donation Experience priorities, and explain the reasoning behind decisions to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Run continuous discovery using customer, GTM, Support, funnel and competitive signals. Separate one-off requests from systemic opportunities and validate problems before anything gets built.
  • Drive delivery end to end with a dedicated Engineering Team Lead, Product Designer and Product Analyst: clear PRDs and edge cases, a backlog that is ready 2–3 sprints ahead, and launches with proper instrumentation.
  • Own product health and enterprise readiness, covering conversion, page performance, reliability, publishing issues and support volume. Resolve deal-breakers and churn-risk requests within agreed SLAs.
  • Partner with PM Growth on experiments, personalisation and ARPV initiatives. Prioritise incoming hypotheses against your own product data, and carry winning learnings across Checkout, Elements and Campaign Pages.
  • Keep Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Support and adjacent PMs aligned. Coordinate dependencies with Platform, Checkout, Gift Cart, Billing and Integrations when work touches shared systems.
  • Make sure GTM, Support and CSMs know what is shipping, why it matters and how to explain it to customers.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. In this role, that means using AI for research synthesis, spec drafting, analysis and communication, with your assumptions and sources made explicit.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS, fundraising, marketing technology, e-commerce or conversion-focused products.
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: roadmap, discovery, execution, launch and measurement.
  • Strong delivery discipline: you write clear specs, cover edge cases and keep Engineering unblocked.
  • Analytical rigour: you use funnels, metrics, support signals and qualitative feedback to prioritise.
  • Systems thinking: you can see how a surface connects to checkout, payments, analytics, integrations and GTM workflows.
  • A working understanding of growth and experimentation: how hypotheses are generated, prioritised and measured.
  • Strong UX sensibility and a good working partnership with Design.
  • Hands-on, everyday AI use in product work.
  • Strong written English and professional spoken English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with landing pages, campaign or website builders, CMS, donation or checkout flows.
  • Hands-on experimentation, personalisation or conversion-optimisation work, including converting paid traffic after it reaches the landing page.
  • Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, payments or marketing operations.
  • Experience handling enterprise customer requests and GTM escalations.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • Own outcomes, not tasks, and don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.
  • Can hold a wide context and still move quickly.
  • Say no to a loud request when the data says something else matters more, and can explain why.
  • Care as much about stability as about the next shiny experiment.
  • Give and ask for candid feedback without ego.
  • Get energy from aligning several teams around one shared goal.
  • Keep sharpening your AI workflow because you want to, not because you were told to.
  • Want your work to translate directly into more money reaching nonprofits.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is GEL12,650 - GEL13,500 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Perks & Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 24 paid vacation days per year
  • 18 paid public holidays per year
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health, offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter. Learn more at calm.com.

What You’ll Do

As a Growth Product Manager on Calm’s direct-to-consumer business, you’ll help more people discover, adopt, and build daily habits with Calm. You’ll own the growth product strategy and roadmap, accountable for driving subscriber growth, activation, revenue per user, and retention. You’ll set the priorities, design and run the experiments that test them, and partner with engineering, product design, marketing, data, and research to ship what works. Your goal is to make it effortless for users to form a lasting mindfulness habit while helping Calm reach and sustain its growth goals.

As a Product Manager working on Calm’s direct-to-consumer business, you will drive measurable impact across top-of-funnel conversion, trial-to-paid transitions, user activation, and long-term retention. You will design, execute, and analyze product experiments in collaboration with engineering, design, marketing, and data science teams.

Day to day, you will:

  • Own growth strategy and roadmap: Develop and own Calm’s growth product strategy and roadmap, translating company revenue, subscriber, and DAU goals into a prioritized set of bets across activation, conversion, and retention.
  • Run a high-velocity experiment program: Form sharp hypotheses, design and ship A/B tests with engineering and data science, and read results honestly — including the ones that don’t win.
  • Remove friction from key journeys: Use quantitative and qualitative data to find where users drop off in onboarding, habit-building, and account flows, then test simpler paths through them.
  • Ship habit mechanics: Build the features that help users plan, track, and celebrate progress, so a first session becomes a daily practice.
  • Write PRDs that make decisions easy : Spell out the job to be done, the opportunity, success metrics, and the plan to ship and iterate — then bring engineers, designers, marketers, and leadership along as the plan changes.

Who You Are

  • A growth PM, or equivalent, who’s owned the number: 4+ years in consumer product, with a track record of owning a growth metric (subscriber growth, conversion, retention) and setting the strategy to move it, across consumer mobile (iOS and Android) and web.
  • A subscription-business operator: Fluent in the economics of consumer subscription (trial and paywall conversion, LTV, churn) and how product decisions show up in them.
  • A rapid experimenter: Experienced in fast experiment design and analysis (A/B tests, holdouts, sequential testing), with the statistical judgment to know when a result is real and when it’s noise.
  • Data-fluent: Adept at sourcing quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize a roadmap and make feature calls, and decisive when the data won’t settle it.
  • A student of habit formation: You know what drives repeat daily usage and how to build the mechanics (streaks, reminders, progress, celebration) that turn a new user into a daily one.
  • AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in leveraging AI tools to drive team velocity and build lasting workflows, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn’t.
  • Technically agile: Comfortable discussing complexity and tradeoffs with engineers, and able to prototype your own ideas rather than wait in a queue.
  • Exceptional at documentation and organization: You keep the experiment log, results archive, and roadmap docs in a state where anyone can find what was tested, what it showed, and what’s live (so the team builds on its own learnings instead of rediscovering them.)
  • A low-ego, persuasive partner: You present your thinking clearly in writing and in the room, to stakeholders and senior leadership alike, hold positions with conviction and update them on evidence, and make Product Design, User Acquisition, Research, and Engineering better for working with you.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in subscription-based consumer tech (onboarding, paywalls, or retention initiatives).
  • Familiarity with product analytics or experimentation tools (e.g., Amplitude).
  • Experience working with or passion for the health & wellness domain.
  • Experience in developing features that drive habit formation and lifestyle change.

Minimum Requirements

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in growth, product management, or equivalent.

Calm uses a geographic pay model that determines salaries based on the location where an employee lives. For this position, the base pay ranges across Calm’s pay tiers is as follows: $147,800 - $226,700. The base pay range represents the low and high end of Calm’s salary range for this position. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. Exact salary will ultimately depend on multiple factors, which include the successful candidate’s geographic location, skills, experience and other qualifications. Calm uses employee zip code to determine which pay range applies. This role is also eligible for equity + comprehensive benefits + 401k + flexible time off.

Calm may incorporate artificial intelligence technology to support the application review process, but rest assured that human reviewers are involved in all stages of the hiring process.

Calm is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or interview process, please contact Calm’s Recruiting team at recruitingaccommodations@calm.com. All accommodation requests will be handled confidentially and assessed on a case-by-case basis.

That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Calm is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. We strive to create a mindful and respectful environment where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, and experience a culture that is free of harassment, racism, and discrimination.

jobs.title: Associate Forward-Deployed Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Tailor

Tailor is a pioneer in Headless ERP technology. Our platform empowers companies to build internal workflows that adapt to their unique needs — faster, smarter, and developer-first.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Associate Forward-Deployed Product Manager to own the day-to-day execution of live client implementations. You’ll be the first line of communication with our clients and the person keeping the project moving — coordinating directly with the internal development team, tracking progress and blockers, running testing and training, and making sure what was committed is what gets delivered. You’ll work collaboratively with the Account Manager and Senior PM (Forward-Deployed Product Manager), who own the commercial relationship and solution design; you own the execution.

This is a development role designed to grow into the Senior PM role. Progression is based on performance and can be accelerated accordingly.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Day-to-Day Client Communications — Manage day-to-day client communications, including question handling, escalation management, and requests to the client, keeping clients informed and unblocked.

  • Drive Project Execution & Tracking — Run the execution rhythm of the project: coordinate with the internal development team, maintain project management tools (e.g., GitHub Projects, Jira), and keep status, documentation, and release notes current for internal and client teams.

  • Client Data & Gap Analysis — Analyze client data to surface gaps, discrepancies, and risks, and support the Senior PM and engineering in solution architecture and functional gap analysis.

  • Testing, Coordination & Go-Live Prep — Validate every release before it reaches the client, coordinate client testing and sign-off, and own go-live readiness. Testing is how we protect client trust — it is a core part of this role.

  • Client Training & Enablement — Create training materials and deliver training so client teams are set up to operate the platform independently.

  • Influence the Platform Roadmap — Develop deep knowledge of the Tailor platform and translate client feedback into product insights that inform the roadmap.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience in product management in either big tech or a startup, and/or management consulting experience; management consulting strongly preferred

  • Proven customer-facing experience, comfortable in front of both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Sharp, structured thinker who is comfortable with ambiguity and eager to learn and grow

  • Ownership mindset with an appetite for operational and technical detail

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable with data analysis tools and AI-driven workflows

Nice to Have

  • You build things in your spare time — show us a side project you’ve vibe coded and walk us through how you approached it

  • Exposure to ecommerce or physical-product operations — order, inventory, purchasing, fulfillment, or accounting workflows

  • Familiarity with ERP, 3PL, or commerce platforms

  • Prior experience onboarding customers onto software

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: USD 100,000 to USD 130,000 yearly

  • Benefits: Health, dental, vision, flexible PTO, and more

Why Tailor?

You’ll work directly with the product team on a fast-growing platform solving real operational pain. If you love being the voice of the customer, reducing friction, and making teams more effective — let’s talk. Apply now and help us shape the future of Headless ERP.

jobs.title: HELOC Closing & Delivery Manager
jobs.jd_full:
ABOUT OUR COMPANY:

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we’ve been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we’ve raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we’re still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we’re just getting started..

ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we’re focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We’re good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

Own It – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

Raise the Bar – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

Say the Hard Thing – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

Elevate Each Other – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we’re collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Splash Financial is seeking a HELOC Closing & Delivery Manager to manage day-to-day closing and investor delivery for our new HELOC lending platform. This individual contributor will coordinate accurate, timely closings and loan delivery, serving as the primary point of contact for borrowers, settlement agents, and investor partners from clear-to-close through loan sale.

Working with the Director, HELOC Operations, this person will help establish and document the workflows that support the program as it grows. The role reports to the Director, HELOC Operations and may have an opportunity to help build and lead a closing team as origination volume increases.

We are hiring for this role in the Cleveland, OH area only. This is a remote role that requires 1–4 days per month in our downtown Cleveland office to support operational processes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO AT SPLASH:

Process Documentation & Improvement

  • Help develop and document HELOC closing and investor-delivery checklists, LOS workflows, remote online notarization (RON) and eClosing procedures, and quality-control standards in partnership with the Director, HELOC Operations.
  • Identify recurring issues in the closing-to-sale process and recommend improvements as the program grows.

Pre-Closing File Review & Readiness

  • Review HELOC files following credit approval to confirm prior-to-closing conditions, disclosures, and closing documents are complete and consistent with program and investor guidelines.
  • Review title commitments or property and lien reports, lien searches, payoff statements, and subordination agreements to confirm lien position and identify title exceptions that need to be resolved before closing.
  • Confirm collateral and insurance requirements are met, including property valuation, flood zone determination and any required flood notice or insurance, and hazard insurance with the correct mortgagee clause.
  • Enter and validate loan data in the LOS and integrated document platforms to generate accurate closing documents, including the HELOC agreement, security instrument, and Notice of Right to Cancel.
  • Escalate unusual file conditions or requirements that fall outside established guidelines.

Closing Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate with settlement agents, borrowers, and investors to schedule and complete in-person, hybrid, and RON eClosings.
  • Serve as the borrower’s primary point of contact from clear-to-close through funding. Explain what to expect at signing and during any applicable rescission period, respond to process questions, and refer questions about loan terms or pricing to licensed staff.
  • Work with underwriting, processing, servicing, and external partners to resolve routine issues and keep files moving toward closing and boarding.

Funding

  • Review executed closing packages for completeness and accuracy, including signatures, dates, notarization, and Notice of Right to Cancel dates. Coordinate corrections before funding.
  • Confirm prior-to-funding conditions are satisfied and any applicable rescission period has expired before authorizing disbursement of initial draws under established procedures.
  • Follow funding controls, including independent call-back verification of settlement agent wire instructions, reconciliation of funding amounts to closing figures, and confirmation of disbursement. Escalate discrepancies before funds are released.

Post-Closing & Investor Delivery

  • Coordinate the transition of closed HELOC loans into the investor sale and delivery pipeline.
  • Track recording of security instruments and other trailing documents. Coordinate collateral file delivery to the document custodian, including eNote registration and eVault steps where applicable.
  • Prepare and submit investor delivery packages and loan data in accordance with investor and program requirements and purchase deadlines.
  • Serve as the day-to-day contact for investor counterparts, resolving routine discrepancies and escalating complex issues to support timely purchase.

Pipeline, Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Manage an assigned pipeline of HELOC files from post-approval through investor sale, meeting closing and delivery deadlines, quality standards, and turn-time targets.
  • Maintain organized, accurate files in accordance with company policy, information security standards, and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Provide files and information for quality control, internal audit, investor due diligence, and regulatory examination requests related to closed and sold loans.
  • Help develop training materials for future closing staff and share process knowledge as the team grows.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO SPLASH:

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 2 years of experience in mortgage or HELOC closing, post-closing, or loan delivery operations.
  • Working knowledge of the HELOC or home equity lending lifecycle, including lien position, subordination, rescission, and investor delivery requirements.
  • Experience reviewing loan files and closing documents for accuracy and resolving discrepancies using established guidelines.
  • Experience with a loan origination system; Vesta experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with eClosing, e-signature, and RON platforms; DocMagic experience is a plus.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple files, prioritize deadlines, and know when to escalate an exception.
  • Strong attention to detail and sound judgment when handling borrower information, closing documents, and funding instructions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work directly with borrowers, settlement agents, investors, and internal partners.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive borrower and financial information.
  • Familiarity with applicable federal and state home equity lending requirements.
  • NMLS licensure is not required for this role.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience helping document or improve closing processes in a new product line or growing lending operation.
  • Experience at a HELOC-focused or home equity lender.
  • Familiarity with eNotes, eVaults, and investor loan sale or delivery processes.
  • Experience training or mentoring closing or processing staff, or interest in growing into a people-management role as the team scales.

COMPENSATION:

The base salary range for this role is $69,000 to $85,000 annually, based on market data and internal compensation practices. Final compensation will be determined by factors such as location, experience, and skill level.

SPLASHERS ENJOY:

  • Fully remote work freedom (for most roles)
  • Competitive salary packages
  • Flexible PTO + 9 company holidays
  • Equity: Share in our start-up success
  • Comprehensive and affordable insurance benefits
  • Paid parental leave for both caregivers
  • Essential modern equipment to get the job done

jobs.title: Product Manager, Dashboard
jobs.jd_full:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what’s next. For more than a decade we’ve helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we’re scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. You will lead the shift from what is a project listing page today to a personalized, agent-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and discover value. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid).

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform
  • Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users
  • Shift the Dashboard from a passive “pull” experience to a proactive “push” experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions
  • Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell
  • Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel
  • Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments

About You:

  • You’ve built and shipped developer-facing products
  • You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies
  • You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple
  • You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces
  • You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions

Bonus If You:

  • Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt
  • Have an engineering background or have built software yourself
  • Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context
  • Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $172,000 - $258,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. jobs.title: IT Project Manager (Remote)
jobs.jd_full:
Job Description

The Project Manager (PM) at Intelligent Technical Solutions (ITS) leads client-facing technology projects in a fast-paced Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. This role is responsible for managing multiple small-to-medium IT projects simultaneously including client onboarding, Microsoft 365 migrations, infrastructure refreshes, network upgrades, and cybersecurity deployments.

The PM ensures all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with both client expectations and ITS’s service standards. Working closely with technical teams, account managers, and service delivery leaders, the PM drives clear communication, structured execution, and exceptional client experience from kickoff to handoff.

Job Responsibilities

Project Ownership & Execution

  • Plan, coordinate, and deliver IT projects for SMB clients such as server/cloud migrations, security stack deployments, and network infrastructure upgrades.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects using ConnectWise Manage.
  • Define project scope, tasks, timelines, and resource assignments using ITS templates and standards.
  • Track and communicate project milestones, dependencies, and risks with clients and internal teams.
  • Ensure seamless handoff to Service Delivery or Support once projects are completed.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution, ensuring consistent communication and expectation management.
  • Partner with Account Managers, vCIOs, and Technical Leads to align project objectives with client needs.
  • Conduct kickoff, status, and closeout meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure partners and vendors are informed of relevant project milestones and deliverables.

Team Leadership & Risk Management

  • Coordinate efforts across engineering, procurement, and service delivery teams to maintain accountability and progress.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate risks before they impact schedule or quality.
  • Proactively manage change requests and ensure project documentation remains current.
  • Uphold ITS’s quality standards and process discipline across all project engagements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Projects delivered on schedule and within defined scope.
  • Clients express high satisfaction with project communication and outcomes.
  • Internal handoffs to Service Delivery occur smoothly and without rework.
  • Documentation is complete, standardized, and audit-ready.
  • Cross-departmental collaboration and visibility are consistently strong.

Job Qualifications

  • 3+ years of project management experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or IT consulting firm.
  • Proven success managing multiple concurrent client projects of varying scope and complexity.
  • Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies (especially Microsoft 365 and Azure), and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience managing client onboarding, technology refresh, or environment migration projects.
  • Proficiency with ConnectWise Manage, and documentation tools like IT Glue.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fully remote, fast-paced, client-facing environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 environments, SharePoint/OneDrive migrations, Azure, and related technologies and PC Deployments.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced MSP environment.
  • Certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Prince 2, ITIL, or Agile/Scrum credentials are a plus.

KPIs

  • Project Closure Rate: Percentage of projects completed on time and within scope.
  • Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Feedback on communication, transparency, and delivery quality.
  • Budget Management: Alignment of resource hours with project budgets.
  • Transition Quality: Smoothness of project-to-support handoffs.
  • Risk Management: Documentation and mitigation of project risks.

Job Requirements

  • A home office set up that meets the following:
    • Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following:
      • Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or
      • AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or
      • macOS 12 or newer.
    • Internet: Stable internet connection with at least 5 Mbps download and upload speeds.
    • Audio Equipment: A quality headset with a noise-cancellation feature for meetings.
    • Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app.
    • Webcam: An HD webcam for video calls.
  • A very strong cultural fit the ITS way (Our core values will be discussed during the interview)
  • Excellent command of the English language both spoken and written
  • Able to work full time 40 hours a week:  8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST (Monday to Friday)
  • Able to pass our online behavior and cognitive assessments.
  • Able to provide NBI Clearance (for PH applicants).

Compensation

Pay rate starts at $8.93/hour and vary by experience and location.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Health Plans / HMO (Employee & Dependent/s)
  • Life Insurance
  • Flexible Benefit Reimbursement (Dental/Vision/Mental Health/Wellness/Government Contributions)
  • Paid Time Off (starts at 15 days per year)
  • Maternity/Paternity Leave
  • Paid US Holiday
  • Night Shift Bonus
  • Salary Advancement/Loan
  • Health & Wellness Program
  • Company-paid training and certification

Fraud Alert – Recruitment Scams

Intelligent Technical Solutions (ITS) has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and communications misrepresenting our company. Applicants are advised to exercise caution and apply only through official ITS channels.

  • ITS does not request payment or financial information at any stage of the hiring process.
  • Sensitive personal information (e.g., Social Security numbers) will not be requested prior to a formal offer.
  • We have become aware of fake profiles on LinkedIn, Facebook, and other social media platforms impersonating our employees and falsely claiming to represent our company. Please exercise caution when interacting with these accounts.
  • If you receive suspicious messages or requests, do not engage. Report them to careers@itsasap.com.
  • All verified job openings are posted here: https://www.itsasap.com/job-openings

jobs.title: Product Manager, Retail Experience
jobs.jd_full:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Vice President of Product and UX

Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office), with regular travel to stores

About the Role

Retail is a growing part of Backcountry’s business, and the customer experience across stores and Backcountry.com needs to feel like one brand rather than two systems. As Product Manager, Retail Experience, you will own the product roadmap for everything that bridges our physical stores and the digital experience.

At six to twelve months, success looks like measurable growth in cross-channel revenue and store conversion, a unified retail experience customers can feel, and a roadmap that store operations, merchandising, and engineering trust and rally behind. You will be building for a store fleet that will look different a year from now than it does today.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product roadmap for retail customer experience, spanning the in-store journey and the digital touchpoints that connect stores to Backcountry.com.
  • Build and improve cross-channel experiences including buy online pick up in store, ship from store, store inventory visibility on product pages and search, and in-store returns.
  • Extend loyalty and customer recognition into the store so that membership, points, and order history work the same at the register as they do online.
  • Partner with store operations and store teams to understand how stores actually run, then translate that into product requirements that hold up on a busy Saturday.
  • Design the customer experience for store services such as rentals, fittings, and tuning — including how customers book, pay, and pick up.
  • Define success metrics for retail initiatives, instrument them properly, and use data and experimentation to decide what to build next.
  • Work with engineering on the systems behind the experience — point of sale, inventory, order management, and customer data — and make smart calls about what to integrate versus what to rebuild.
  • Create repeatable playbooks and requirements so that bringing a new store or group of stores onto the experience is a known process rather than a one-off project.
  • Partner across engineering, design, merchandising, marketing, analytics, and operations to turn business goals into shipped product.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of product management experience.
  • Experience owning retail, omnichannel, or in-store customer experience, or closely adjacent commerce products.
  • Working understanding of retail systems such as point of sale, inventory and order management, and customer data platforms.
  • Demonstrated impact on conversion, revenue, or operational efficiency with measurable results.
  • Strong analytical and experimentation skills, with experience using GA4, Looker, SQL, or similar tools.
  • Ability to ship iteratively and keep momentum through rapid release cycles.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including store leadership and field teams.
  • Willingness to travel to stores regularly and to work onsite three days per week in Utah.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools within product workflows — pulling live context from project and documentation tools, prototyping instead of slide-decking, and automating repetitive work.
  • Experience launching product in new stores, new markets, or newly integrated businesses.
  • Experience with rental, service, or appointment-based retail models.
  • Background in outdoor, specialty, or hardgoods retail.

Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Team Impact: Own the customer experience for a part of the business Backcountry is actively investing in and growing, and build a team/cross-functional initiatives that deliver against it.
  • Ground-Floor Scope: Shape how retail and digital fit together while the patterns are still being set — not inherit someone else’s. Product leadership and strategic influence grow alongside the product.
  • Full Ownership: Own team performance and delivery end to end, from roadmap through shipped product, with the autonomy to make real calls.
  • Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
  2. Take-Home Challenge - A short AI or product building exercise so we can see how you approach problems and execution.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview - A deep dive with the Vice President of Product and UX on your experience, product mindset, and operational thinking.
  4. Leadership and Store Operations Interviews - Conversations with the partners you will work with most closely across store operations and senior leadership.
  5. In-Person Interview - We’d like to meet you, and you should see a store. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
  6. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
  7. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note

Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer.  Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact [email protected].

Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise Solutions
jobs.jd_full:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada is a leading provider of virtual-first care for weight health, diabetes, hypertension, and musculoskeletal issues. As a Senior Product Manager for Enterprise Solutions, you will lead advance discovery and help to shape strategic customer partnerships in support of Omada’s expansion into the payer, PBM and Provider ecosystem. You will operate between product squads and commercial teams, identifying gaps and opportunities, and advocating for the problems we should be solving with customers and potential partners. You will directly support the Senior Director, Product in high impact special projects. This is a dynamic position in which you will get exposure to many aspects of the business, and will have an opportunity to partner closely with other product managers on the team to build innovative programs and tools.

About you:

  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • 10+ years of a combination of market and/or product strategy, product management, general management, software development, consulting, product or business operations
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience
  • Passionate about building experiences that people love to use
  • Able to think beyond constraints to imagine new ways to enroll and engage members
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills with strong technical understanding
  • At home in ambiguous or green field opportunity spaces, with a track record of successfully bringing 0-1 products to market
  • Adept at solving problems with limited resources, and proactively advocating for whatever it is you need to succeed
  • Strong writer and clear communicator
  • Collaborative, and able to drive alignment in a group of stakeholders
  • Comfortable analyzing data and leading research/discovery efforts to understand a problem space, identify opportunities, and propose solutions
  • Human-centered product development and Continuous Discovery experience a plus
  • Experience leveraging AI/ML to personalize products and build efficient workflows a plus
  • Prior experience at a healthcare company a plus, especially in partnership with health insurers or PBMs
  • Prior experience with provider-side integrations, especially Epic is a plus

Your impact:

In this role, you’ll partner closely with our commercial organization to identify high impact partnership opportunities and shape the potential integration or product support the opportunity will require. You will:

  • Expand our partnership with PBMs and health insurers by making Omada the first choice in their portfolio for virtual-first care
  • Explore new verticals for Omada, like Provider partnerships as potential avenues for enrollments and member engagement
  • Cultivate an innovative environment that challengesyour cross-functional peers to think in new ways
  • Mentor and support other PMs on the team to hone their product management skills
  • Establish best practices for proactively tracking progress against corporate and team objectives

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • …and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today’s healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions.
